about: Latest live state of the Canary Wharf / Docklands zone and the last 24 hours, written by cwplans/tools/cache-londat.mjs (danbri/londat) from the history in this folder. Times: ISO UTC. Each theme keeps the licence of its source (sources).
history: cache/runs/2026-10-DD/live-*.json.gz (this month, one file per run); cache/live-YYYY-MM.sqlite (closed months)

From 1100 until 1900, westbound trains will not call at Burnham or Taplow, and after 1900, no trains call at Burnha

There is no service on the Cable Car due to high winds. Nearby alternatives include taking the Jubilee Line from North Greenwich to Canning Town and changing to the DLR heading to Beckton.
